禁止野排使用，影响他人体验，单机玩玩和组排开黑玩玩就好，素质你我他

这是我做的第一个mod，使用吃白饭大肥鱼制作，学艺不精，如有问题请及时反馈，我会想办法修复
This is my first mod. It was created with AI assistance. I am still new to modding, so please report any issues promptly, and I will try my best to fix them.

初衷是不喜欢原版反器材泼水似的射击方式，玩着也轻飘飘的没什么反器材武器的实感，就想着做一个手感厚重的真反器材重狙，数据是根据a网一个光环武器以及反器材无后座大改mod修改而来的，因为是第一次做mod，没有技术力没法做类似泰坦陨落2的克莱博的拉栓重狙，就只能先改个反器材的了，以后会考虑做别的，以下是mod修改后的数据

Do not use in matchmaking, as it will negatively affect other players' experience.

I didn’t like the high fire rate of the vanilla anti-materiel rifle — it lacks the imposing aura that an anti-materiel weapon should have. I wanted to create a genuine heavy anti-materiel sniper with a weighty feel. The stats are adapted from other anti-materiel mods on Nexus Mods.

Since this is my first modding project, I don’t yet have the technical ability to create a bolt-action sniper like the Kraber from Titanfall 2. So I started by reworking this anti-materiel rifle instead. I may work on other mods in the future. Below are the modified stats of this mod.



推荐使用tg-8战锤甲，手感大大提升
TG-8 Warhammer 40k crossover armor is recommended; it vastly improves handling.

这是mod演示视频
This is the mod demo video.
https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1STHd6hExW/?vd_source=74c85fbc58f53d1f03ba841389c5d4c7

经过小小商议，做了一个再平衡版本，耐久伤害调低至480，卡阈值4发才能击杀泰坦，射速降低至60，换弹速度降低至4.5s，垂直后坐力提高至500，请酌情选择
After a brief discussion, a rebalanced variant has been added. Durability damage is lowered to 480. The stats are tuned to hit the threshold: it takes 4 shots to eliminate a Titan. fire rate reduced to 60, reload time increased to 4.5s, and vertical recoil raised to 500. Please choose whichever fits your preference.

另外，推荐使用一些看着比较重型的反器材建模和音效mod替换，比如光环狙和克莱博会更有感觉，演示中使用的是光环狙和它的音效替换
Additionally, it is recommended to replace the model and sound effects with heavy anti-materiel mod assets. Options such as the Halo sniper rifle and the Kraber from Titanfall 2 work great for immersion. The demo uses the Halo sniper rifle along with its sound effect replacements.
https://www.nexusmods.com/helldivers2/mods/10222
